bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.citation: Gerald Teschl, Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems, Graduate Studies in Mathematics 140, American Mathematical Society, 2012
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.candidate_locator: Section 6.5, printed pages 199-200, equation (6.32), and Problem 6.17
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.candidate_summary: Presents the scalar ODE x' = mu*x - x^2 as a prototypical transcritical bifurcation and says its equilibria collide and exchange stability at mu = 0
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.errata_search_result: no text match for bifurcation, transcritical, printed pages 199-200, or equations 6.31-6.33; discovery observation only
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.source_issue: The sentence calls both noncritical fixed points stable while also saying they exchange stability. For the displayed vector field the state derivatives at x = 0 and x = mu are mu and -mu, so the adjacent one-dimensional derivative criterion gives one stable and one unstable equilibrium for each nonzero mu. This apparent typo or inconsistency is unresolved in the inspected errata.
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.status: author-hosted publisher-permitted preliminary edition inspected for source-family discrimination only; the catalog does not cite or select it, Problem 6.17 delegates proof of the example statements, the wording issue is unresolved, and no immutable H0 admission or independent review is credited
